registers.label: Spare
lines: A bush was burning and was not consumed.
Take off your shoes; this ground is holy.
Moses asked the name, and God said, I AM.
The God of our ancestors has heard us.
Take up your cross, says Jesus, and follow me.
We will lose our lives to find them.
Come, let us worship on holy ground.
We come; here we are. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: See the bush ablaze on the mountainside, the flame leaping and the branches whole, burning and not burning up.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
Moses turned aside to look, and out of the fire a voice called his name and told him to take off his shoes.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
When he asked who was sending him, the answer was the name above all names: I AM WHO I AM.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
The same God who would not be consumed calls us to take up the cross and follow, losing our lives to save them.
Here we are; this ground is holy. Send us, Lord!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A bush burned on the mountain and was not consumed.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
God spoke from the fire and gave the name: I AM.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
Take up your cross, says Jesus, and follow me.
Here we are; this ground is holy.
Come, let us worship the God who calls and sends.
Here we are; this ground is holy. Amen.
